card.name: Linking words before a combination partner
card.fires_on: The word "with" (sometimes "and") right after "in combination" or a dose, just before a second drug name in cancer drug dosing text. Also fires on a few similar linking words before a noun or name.

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: "with" after "in combination" or a dose, before the partner drug.
modes.example: Administer KEYTRUDA in combination<< with>> belzutifan 12

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A small word such as "a", "contact" or "using" just before the object phrase.
modes.example: finding<< a>> job," says the rising college senior.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that links one drug to the partner drug it is given with.
